title: Analysis of Cannabinoids in Bovine Plasma Using Solid Phase Extraction & UPLC MS/MS
author: Geraldine Magnin
materials: 100 µL of NEG CTRL bovine plasma
IS control: In a 1.5-mL microcentrifuge tube, mix:
Standard: In a 1.5-mL microcentrifuge tube, mix:
100 µL of working standard in ACN

steps.title: Prepare Cannabinoids Stock Mixture
steps.instruction: Prepare a stock solution of analytes at 10 µg/mL in ACN in a 4-mL glass vial.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µL each of CBC, CBCA, CBD, CBD-7-acid, CBDA, CBDV, CBDVA, CBG, CBGA, CBLA, CBN, 8-THC, 9-THC, THCA-A, THCP, and THCV (all at 10,000 µg/mL).
Add 200 µL of THC-11-acid and THC-11-OH (at 100 µg/mL).
Add 40 µL of CBL (at 500 µg/mL).
Add 1240 µL of ACN.
Aliquot the stock solution into 0.5-mL portions and store at -20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Internal Standards (IS) Stock Mixture
steps.instruction: Prepare an internal standards mixture at 10 µg/mL in ACN in a 4-mL glass vial.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL each of THC-11-acid-glu-d3, THC-11-OH-d3, THC-11-acid-d9, 9-THC-d3, CBD-d3, CBC-d9, and THCA-A-d3 (all at 100 µg/mL).
Add 600 µL of ACN.
Aliquot the stock IS solution into 0.5-mL portions and store at -20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare IS Working Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare an IS working solution at 100 ng/mL in ACN-0.1% formic acid.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL of IS mixture at 10 ng/mL to 9.9 mL of ACN-0.1% formic acid.

steps.title: Prepare Daily Cannabinoid Standard Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh standard solutions in ACN-0.1% formic acid in 1.5-mL polypropylene microcentrifuge tubes.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1,000 ng/mL mix: 100 µL cannabinoids working solution (10 µg/mL in ACN), 10 µL THC-11-acid-glu (100 µg/mL), 100 µL THC-glu (10 µg/mL), and 790 µL ACN.
Prepare 950 ng/mL mix: 475 µL of 1,000 ng/mL mix and 25 µL ACN.
Prepare 475 ng/mL mix: 100 µL of 950 ng/mL mix and 100 µL ACN.
Prepare 47.5 ng/mL mix: 50 µL of 475 µg/mL [sic] mix and 450 µL ACN.
Prepare 100 ng/mL mix: 100 µL of 1,000 ng/mL mix and 900 µL ACN.
Prepare 50 ng/mL mix: 50 µL of 1,000 ng/mL mix and 950 µL ACN.
Prepare 25 ng/mL mix: 25 µL of 1,000 ng/mL mix and 975 µL ACN.
Prepare 10 ng/mL mix: 100 µL of 100 ng/mL mix and 900 µL ACN.
Prepare 5 ng/mL mix: 100 µL of 50 ng/mL mix and 900 µL ACN.
Prepare 2.5 ng/mL mix: 100 µL of 25 ng/mL mix and 900 µL ACN.
Prepare 1.0 ng/mL mix: 100 µL of 10 ng/mL mix and 900 µL ACN.

steps.title: Prepare Quality Controls (QCs)
steps.instruction: Prepare QCs in negative control bovine plasma in 1.5-mL microcentrifuge tubes.

substeps.instruction: QC3 (95 ng/mL): Add 10 µL of 950 ng/mL mix to 990 µL negative control bovine plasma.
QC2 (47.5 ng/mL): Add 10 µL of 475 ng/mL mix to 990 µL negative control bovine plasma.
QC1 (4.75 ng/mL): Add 10 µL of 47.5 ng/mL mix to 990 µL negative control bovine plasma.

steps.title: Prepare Negative Control
steps.instruction: Prepare negative control in a 1.5-mL microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Mix 100 µL of IS mixture at 100 ng/mL in ACN-formic acid 0.1% and 100 µL of IS working mixture at 100 ng/mL in ACN-formic acid 0.1%.

steps.title: Sample Preparation and Extraction
steps.instruction: Process samples and QCs using Solid Phase Extraction (SPE).

substeps.instruction: In a 1.5-mL microcentrifuge tube, mix sample/QC with 100 µL of internal standard mixture at 100 ng/mL in ACN-0.1% formic acid.
Vortex for 5 seconds and centrifuge for 5 minutes at 13,000 g.
Transfer supernatant to another 1.5-mL tube and dilute with 0.4 mL of water.
Stack an HLB µElution plate on a waste collection plate.
Load diluted supernatant into wells using positive pressure with nitrogen.
Wash each well twice with 250 µL of MeOH-water (25:75).
Stack the HLB µElution plate on a clean collection plate.
Elute cannabinoids with 2 x 25 µL aliquots of ACN-MeOH (90:10).
Add 50 µL of water with 0.2% formic acid to each well.
Stack a cap mat on top and mix gently.

steps.title: UPLC MS/MS Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze samples using a Waters Acquity H UPLC and TQ-S triple quadrupole mass spectrometer.

substeps.instruction: Set column to Eclipse Plus C18 (100 x 2.1 mm, 1.8 µm) at 55 °C.
Set autosampler compartment to 8 °C.
Set flow rate to 0.5 mL/min and injection volume to 5 µL.

Apply gradient: 0.00 min (40% ACN, 60% 0.1% aq. formic acid) to 6.50 min (14% ACN, 86% aq. formic acid); 6.51 min (0% ACN, 100% aq. formic acid) until 7.50 min; 7.51 min (40% ACN, 60% aq. formic acid) until 10.00 min.
Configure MS source: Temperature 150 °C, Desolvation 550 °C, Desolvation Gas Flow 1,000 L/hour, Cone 150 L/hour, Nebulizer 7.0 bar, Capillary 3.0 kV.
Operate in MRM mode using ESI+ and ESI- as specified in the MRM parameters table.
